name: io.github.drolosoft/immich-photo-manager
title: Immich Photo Manager
description: Photo management for self-hosted Immich: search, albums, duplicates, faces, PDF reports. 94 tools.

environmentVariables.name: IMMICH_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: URL of your Immich server, for example https://photos.example.com

environmentVariables.name: IMMICH_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Immich API key (Account Settings, API Keys). Both variables can also be set later from the client with the update_credentials tool.

runtimeArguments.name: -p
runtimeArguments.description: Publish the MCP port; the server listens on 8626 inside the container

runtimeArguments.name: -v
runtimeArguments.description: Directory on the host for the PDFs and zips the tools write, and for credentials set from the client

environmentVariables.name: IMMICH_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: URL of your Immich server. Optional at start: without it every tool answers with the fix and one update_credentials call connects the container.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_ALLOWED_HOSTS
environmentVariables.description: Extra hostnames the container may be reached under (a reverse proxy, another container). DNS-rebinding protection stays on.
